newsitem.title: UK: Sema wins UK government IT deal.
newsitem.headline: Sema wins UK government IT deal.

text.p: Sema Group Plc has won a five year contract to develop, support and maintain the Department of Social Security's non-mainframe computer systems, the Department's Information Technology Services Agency (ITSA) said on Thursday.
It said the deal, which may be extended to seven years if performance is satisfactory, will mean 125 ITSA staff transferring to Sema.
The Department has 740 non-strategic IT applications ranging from a single personal computer to networked applications running up to 200 PCs.

"Outsourcing these will enable the Department to concentrate its Information Systems and Information Technology expertise on the development and maintenance of strategic mainframe systems," ITSA said in a statement.
It did not give the value of the contract.
